- Published: 2024-08-18

- URL: https://www.buildingsguide.com/legal/refunds-returns/

BuildingsGuide is dedicated to delivering high-quality metal buildings tailored to meet your unique needs. Our return and refund policy is outlined below to maintain transparency and ensure your satisfaction throughout the purchase and construction process. Order Placement and Cancellation   Non-refundable building deposit When you place your order, you must make a deposit. After signing the agreement and placing the 25% deposit, the total amount will be refundable for 24 hours. After 24 hours, it will become non-refundable. A deposit is required to receive CAD drawings. The remaining balance is due before your building enters the manufacturing stage. Exceptions may be made for significant personal or business emergencies; please contact us directly in these cases.   Cancellation policy Before fabrication: If you cancel your order before fabrication begins, we will refund any payments minus the non-refundable deposit. After fabrication: Once fabrication has commenced, the building is custom-made, and no refunds can be issued. The customer must accept the finished building kit package.   Fabrication and delivery Fabrication process: Standard buildings typically require about one month for fabrication. Depending on the specifications, larger or more complex structures may take three to six months. Delays are possible during peak seasons (spring and summer months). Delivery schedule: Delivery times vary from 4 to 10 days across North America, with specific timelines provided in your contract. Please be available on the scheduled delivery date to avoid additional charges for missed deliveries.   Defective products and damage We encourage you to inspect your building kit...

- URL: https://www.buildingsguide.com/design/floor-plan-maker/

Free Floor Plan Maker Our easy-to-use floor plan tool saves you time when drawing manual plans and layouts for your new building project. We developed this online app to help anyone looking to visualize their new metal building layout quickly and easily. Use the tool to plan any of the following: the number of cars that will fit in a new metal garage, the number of horse stalls for a new horse barn, and runs that will fit in a commercial dog kennel building. To use the tool, enter the dimensions of your proposed building and select any pre-defined objects to add to the layout. Once these have been added, you can rotate and move them around to help you understand how much floor space you will need for your new structure. Also, once you have your objects in place, be sure to add doors and windows to the walls to get an idea of the door sizes that will be required. We are constantly updating our floorplan design software with new objects and features and intend to add the ability to create home plans with the next update. If you would like to request a feature, please contact us with details of what you would like to include. For pre-designed floorplan and layout ideas, see our metal building plans, garage plans, and Shouse floor plans
